name: Partle
description:
Search for products available in physical stores near you. Find prices, stock, and store locations
for hardware, tools, and construction supplies. Useful when you need something today and can't wait
for delivery.

5 tools: search products, search stores, get product details, get store details, list categories. No
authentication required. Covers ~2400 products across ~4000 stores in Spain.
